Info

Compiles auxiliary hardware commands (PUMP, VALVE, WAIT, HOME) into binary frames and steps.

class scarajectory.core.service.dsl.binary.command.command_compiler.CommandCompiler(*, frame_builder: IBinaryFrameBuilder)[source]¶

Bases: object

Compiles semantic hardware commands into binary wire frames and binary steps.

It defines:

attributes:
_frame_builder - Binary frame assembler protocol.
methods:

_frame_builder: IBinaryFrameBuilder¶
compile_command_step(*, command: str, seq_num: int, line_num: int) → Step[source]¶

Compiles a semantic command string into a binary command step.

Parameters:

  • command – Command text (e.g. PUMP, VALVE, WAIT, HOME).

  • seq_num – Cyclic sequence counter.

  • line_num – Source line index.

Returns:

Compiled Step.
